content.text: Theo's at 5 months, so you're close. Most babies are ready around 6 months, and Canadian guidance says to start about then. Until then, milk is still all he needs. The signs to watch for are sitting with little support, good head control, and reaching for your food. When he's there, offer a little iron-rich food, like iron-fortified cereal or well-mashed meat, once a day. It's general guidance, so confirm timing with your provider or public health.
